Read a per-study file

Source: R/studies.R
cmgd_read_study.Rd

Downloads (via cmgd_download(), so cached and verified) and reads one of a study's ready-made files:

Usage

cmgd_read_study(rel, study, what = names(study_file_names),
    cache = cmgd_cache_dir())

Arguments

rel

A release from cmgd_release().

study

Study name, for example "ZellerG_2014".

what

Which file to read.

cache

Cache directory.

Value

A data.frame.

Details

  • metaphlan_species: species x samples relative abundance (percent) from the main MetaPhlAn pass on all reads; column clade_name then one column per sample_key; 0 means not detected. Every sample in qc has a column: a sample with no species-level rows is an all-zero column.

  • metaphlan, bracken, resistome, pathways (HUMAnN datasets only): the study's rows of the corresponding release table, in long form. These are Parquet, read with duckdb.

  • qc: one row per sample with read counts and run_ids.

Examples

rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0", release = "2026-10-16")
# Downloads go to the cache; tempdir() keeps them out of yours.
qc <- cmgd_read_study(rel, "ZellerG_2014", "qc", cache = tempdir())
